scope: Focused clinical literature review; eight sources, seven full papers plus one abstract/official-code study. Not systematic-review prevalence estimation.

sources.title: CPGPrompt: Translating Clinical Guidelines into LLM-Executable Decision Support
sources.primary_type: primary preprint; journal publication independently identified
sources.representation: JSON threshold decision tree: name, yes_action, no_node, criteria:[str], min_criteria:int.
sources.method: Manual passage selection; LLM local subtrees; merge; every tree manually validated, with regeneration and manual adjustment; LLM leaf queries.
sources.verification_guarantee: Program applies min_criteria before a group action; no source-equivalence theorem.
sources.not_guaranteed: No automated extraction fidelity rate; no recursive criterion AST; binary response parser lacks unknown; free-text leaf semantics remain LLM-dependent.
sources.evaluation: Synthetic referral/pathway evaluation. Table 2 headache binary F1 .90 and fine-grained macro F1 .44; low-back-pain set has 99/99 referral-positive cases. Vignettes were generated from validated trees; three clinicians checked 10 cases per domain, so the execution test is not an independent check of source omissions shared with those trees.
sources.transfer_to_repo: 522: group threshold distinct from leaf support. 74/49: path and patient-query correctness remain separate. Do not copy name identity or sequential no-branch merge.

sources.title: Text2MDT: Extracting Medical Decision Trees from Medical Texts
sources.representation: Binary decision tree; node Role, Triplets, Logical_Rel (AND/OR/NULL); preorder serialization.
sources.method: Expert-involved Chinese annotation; triples → node grouping → assembly, compared with instruction-tuned end-to-end models and CoT variants.
sources.verification_guarantee: Human-reference exact whole-tree accuracy and decision-path F1; these measure agreement within the supported representation.
sources.not_guaranteed: Authors explicitly limit node logical combinations, multi-stage action continuation, and cross-paragraph knowledge. No general quantified FOL or zero-error guarantee.
sources.evaluation: Table 4: Baichuan2-7B CoT-Generation-3 TreeAcc .490, DP-F1 .632; pipeline .470/.631. Table 3 assembly-subtask .748 is not end-to-end fidelity. Test set n=100; reported scores average five runs, not one run with exactly 49/100 correct.
sources.transfer_to_repo: 522: separate atom/group/tree scores and preserve logical_rel. 56: condition and action roles cannot collapse into one disease relation. Multi-depth structure remains harder.

source_locations.code_access: Paper-linked repo and API main/master returned unavailable/404 on access date; code not inspected.

sources.title: MedDM: LLM-executable clinical guidance tree for clinical decision-making
sources.representation: Natural-language clinical guidance tree, root/condition/action nodes; hierarchical If/Elif/Else text (IEET).
sources.method: Flowchart shape/OCR/edge recognition, manual calibration and repair, then CGT conversion and further manual validation.
sources.verification_guarantee: Explicit Yes/No/Unable-to-determine interaction and inspectable flowchart paths; manual quality process, not formal equivalence proof.
sources.not_guaranteed: Already-structured source diagrams; no automatic source-fidelity rate or population-level diagnostic performance shown. Unknown fallback may ask LLM over subtree.
sources.evaluation: 1202 curated trees: 443 differential diagnosis, 759 treatment. Two-pass flowchart calibration by 8 graduate students; later transformation validation by 7.
sources.transfer_to_repo: 74/522: unknown must remain a state. Source diagram arrows aid direction; natural-language node interpretation still needs clinical audit. Cyclic workflow conversion can change semantics.

source_locations.code_access: No official implementation link located in paper or targeted title/GitHub searches.

sources.title: Automatic Conversion of NICE Guidelines to an Executable Computational Model Using Large Language Models
sources.primary_type: primary journal paper, Learning Health Systems e70114
sources.representation: ASP constants, predicates, rules; Clingo executes patient facts plus normative rules; cardinality/choice constructs.
sources.method: D2K: constants → predicates → rules with six shared examples. K2P: LLM patient fact extraction. Three clinician reviewers compare source, ASP, controlled-language rendering.
sources.verification_guarantee: Executable stable-model semantics conditional on supplied rules/facts; source fidelity assessed empirically, not proven.
sources.not_guaranteed: Temporal procedure omissions, arity/qualifier loss, extraneous/missing patient facts, negation-as-failure on incomplete records. Hallucination definition broader than this repo audit.
sources.evaluation: 20 pancreatic vignettes: mean recommendation F1 .825±.127; activate about64% of rules. Public reviewer CSV denominators and values differ from paper figure; separate recomputation below.
sources.transfer_to_repo: 49/74: procedural order is not simple negation. 56/773: patient binding separated from guideline translation. Fixed source units needed before interpreting faithful/omitted percentages.

reviewer_csv_recomputation.definition: Mean of each of three reviewers category count / their CSV row count; categories 0 no-rule,1 correct,2 incorrect,3 missing-key-information,4 hallucination. These are row-rating percentages, not fixed-source faithful recall.

sources.title: From Guidelines to Code: Formalizing STOPP/START Criteria Using LLMs and RAG for Clinical Decision Support
sources.representation: Python using expert-built Speak-PIM classes, condition presence/absence and STOPP/START actions; standardized ICD-10/LOINC/ATC entities.
sources.method: GPT-4o-mini extracts entities and maps retrieved codes; DeepSeek generates code with a one-shot example and framework constraints.
sources.verification_guarantee: Preliminary manual checks of entity extraction, mappings, class signatures and rule logic; no theorem or complete executable test suite reported.
sources.not_guaranteed: Only10 difficulty-selected rules; small observation count; manual framework took months; reproducibility concerns. Medication advice is not diagnosis confirmation.
sources.evaluation: Five STOPP/five START; reported entity extraction and framework logic correct; mapping F1 disease .92, medication .90, observation1.00.
sources.transfer_to_repo: 56/91: ontology mapping must retain assay/concept identity. 522/773: performed test and result are different types. START/STOP action direction is distinct from diagnostic exclusion.

source_locations.code_access: No public pipeline implementation found in paper or targeted title/Speak-PIM searches.

sources.title: CliCARE: Grounding Large Language Models in Clinical Guidelines for Decision Support over Longitudinal Cancer Electronic Health Records
sources.representation: Patient temporal event KG separate from normative guideline KG; path alignment and LLM recommendation generation.
sources.method: Timestamped event extraction/ontology linkage; guideline summarization→structured JSON→Neo4j; sum-of-max similarity path ranking, LLM rerank and expansion.
sources.verification_guarantee: Temporal and workflow representations are inspectable; no logical entailment or automated source-fidelity guarantee.
sources.not_guaranteed: KG edge presence is not AND/OR evaluation. Matching formula does not enforce distinct witnesses or order; source summarization remains lossy. Clinical output judge scores are not extractor precision.
sources.evaluation: CancerEHR and MIMIC-Cancer summary/recommendation evaluation using a clinician-validated LLM judge; source-rule exact fidelity not reported.
sources.transfer_to_repo: 49/74: event timestamps and normative/descriptive separation useful. 522/773: do not inherit sum-max counting or treat stage/biomarker strings as typed predicates.

sources.title: MedGuideX: Internalizing Decision Logic from Executable Guidelines into Large Language Models for Clinical Reasoning
sources.representation: Finite Boolean decision trees compiled to Python f(X); executable factual/counterfactual supervision for SFT/RL.
sources.method: Extract actionable recommendations; LLM tree validation; compile and test syntax/executability/tree consistency; execute functions for labels and rewards.
sources.verification_guarantee: Labels consistent with accepted executable function on evaluated inputs; no guarantee function or variable schema matches source semantics.
sources.not_guaranteed: No independently adjudicated source-level fidelity rate found. Complete Boolean assignments hide clinical unknowns. Counterfactual filtering discards unchanged outputs.
sources.evaluation: Appendix C:3796 retained recommendations→2800 LLM-validated trees→2793 executable functions. These are filtering yields, not extraction accuracy. Physician preference study evaluates30 already-correct diagnostic cases.
sources.transfer_to_repo: 74/522: program-derived paired tests are promising; retain invariant as well as changing examples. 49/56/773: ensure source/binding oracle before self-consistent program supervision.

source_locations.code_access: No official implementation link found in full text or targeted title/author searches.

sources.title: Decision Tree Extraction for Clinical Decision Support System With If-Else Pseudocode and PlanSelect Strategy
sources.primary_type: primary journal abstract plus official implementation
sources.representation: If/elif/else pseudocode skeleton filled with extracted triples; node role C/D and logical_rel and/or/null.
sources.method: Pseudocode structure followed by constrained triplet selection and node logic; inspectable intermediate files and tree/path equality evaluator.
sources.verification_guarantee: Official evaluator includes role, logical_rel and triples in tree/path equality; no source-equivalence guarantee.
sources.not_guaranteed: Full publisher PDF could not be fetched; do not cite unverified comparative numerical gains. Code permits condition deletion when no triple found and compresses descendants; single node logic remains and/or.
sources.evaluation: Official abstract reports Text2DT/EMDT and downstream CMBClin/MedQA. Local read confirms metrics implementation, not the reported score reproducibility.
sources.transfer_to_repo: 522: separate skeleton, leaf alignment and logic; 56/74: node-fill failure must not silently promote a decision into a broader scope. Relation type determines C/D, so relation errors remain causal.
